title: Platform Hardware Features Registry
description: Layer C — static catalog of atomic hardware features. Referenced by Layer A `requires_hardware_features[]` and by consumer-side `cluster.yaml` composite capabilities via `requires_features[]`.

hardware_features.description: Array of atomic hardware feature definitions. Order is non-significant; lookup is by id.
hardware_features.$comment: id uniqueness cannot be expressed in JSON Schema 2020-12 (the former uniqueItemProperties keyword is an AJV-only extension that check-jsonschema silently ignores); it is enforced mechanically by scripts/lint-hardware-features.sh.

id.description: Kebab-case identifier. Referenced by Layer A `requires_hardware_features[]` and by cluster.yaml composite capability `requires_features[]`.

description.description: Prose explanation. Multi-line block style allowed.

discovery_source.description: How a node would learn it has this feature.

node_label_key.description: Authoritative label key asserting the feature is present. REQUIRED when discovery_source is nfd, talos-machine-config, or device-plugin. Nullable for external-bios-or-firmware (no kernel-observable label exists).

presence_predicate.description: Prose condition that, when true on a node, justifies setting the node_label_key value.

alt_label_keys.description: Additional label keys downstream consumers may match (e.g. NFD upstream key plus the Layer-C `platform.io/hardware-feature.<id>` mirror). Informational; not enforced.

allOf.description: node_label_key is required (non-null, non-empty) when discovery_source is nfd, talos-machine-config, or device-plugin.
